compute_binary_log_likelihood: compute the binary log likelihood loss for a batch of 1D binary inputs and output logits
compute_gaussian_log_likelihood: compute the gaussian log likelihood loss for standardized inputs given mean and log variance arrays
compute_latent_kl_divergence: compute the KL divergence of a latent distribution with respect to a standard normal prior
compute_latent_kl_from_network_output: compute the latent KL divergence from an OutputWithPrior network output containing latent mean and log variance
get_log_likelihood_fn: get a callable log likelihood function for either a Bernoulli or Gaussian decoder given a batch
